cases.case_label: Apparent Alu insertion in MAN2B1 (in trans with missense)
cases.mechanism_detail: An apparent Alu insertion, first seen as an uncalled CNV on exome, was found in trans with a missense variant in a patient with biochemically confirmed alpha-mannosidosis; molecular effect not described.
cases.quote: the phenotype-guided analysis helped us detect and interpret an in-trans apparent alu-element insertion
